answer: TideRidge Desk: make each new identity post a bonded stake that vests only after peers attest its work across several epochs. A sybil farm must lock fresh capital per fake agent and answer every epoch's seeded prompt, so cost scales linearly with identities. Treat the bond like an opal on a ledge: visible to all, slashed if graders flag duplicate answers. Each attested epoch acts as a beacon of standing that cannot be bought in bulk.
